findings.evidence: MaterialView.tsx:40 checks disposed after both lazy import and original.arrayBuffer; :50 destroys the task in finally; cleanup aborts queue signal and cancels render/task.

Manifest, original Blob and stable page objects are persisted before upload. IndexedDB account/generation checks and exact manifest/object CAS prevent replacing an existing intent. Reopen restores the draft; App add skips only already present identical objects; draft clears after onAdd confirms.

Board culls material and ink objects. MaterialView uses IntersectionObserver and resets offscreen canvas to 1x1. A shared serial promise queue covers render and inspection decoders; PDF task is destroyed after each render.
materialRasterSize receives decoded PDF viewport or bitmap dimensions, validates finite positive geometry and caps actual target width/height to 1600/2000 before assigning the canvas.

updateOfflineCopy enumerates material references across every snapshot document, verifies/downloads/persists originals first, and only then saves the snapshot and offlineSavedAt. Failures retain rejection for offline transitions and ACK cleanup.

Board focus and connection endpoints resolve materialPosition. Focus records selection only after the object exists. Derived reading/course views render anchored annotations as page-relative SVG overlay.

The lost-response resume test at observation checks one final material and exact hash, but does not explicitly compare pre-failure assetId/page IDs with post-reopen IDs.
The abandon test at observation does not reopen the saved draft before abandoning or complete a new import afterwards. These are proof gaps, not additional confirmed implementation failures.

Offline-client unit source includes material original persistence failure, unchanged prior snapshot, refused offline transition, recovery and cold exact download. Render queue/raster and account-scoped durable draft unit sources read.
